data.rationale: The proposal gets the procedure right: the same weather → BBC → mail steps in the same order with matching subject and body templates. But it splits the single {traveler} parameter into recipient_email and an undefined {name}, it notes the top BBC result without opening it, and it says "send or discard" when the true workflow must never send and always discard, so it can't be safely automated as written.
